text:
I’ve been so grateful for Dr. Kittipan’s help with varicose veins. I recently had an easy, minor surgery to correct varicose vein leakage and was thrilled with the results.

A friend recommended Dr. Kittipan to me as a very kind, caring doctor. Upon meeting him, I found that to be very true. He is so personable and easy to talk to. I felt perfectly comfortable being able to ask him questions and talk about my vein problems. He speaks English perfectly which made our conversations very easy.

At Dr. Kittipan‘s clinic, he used ultrasound to show me the problem with vein leakage. He discussed this with me and showed me photos of ulcers that can occur if this type of vein is left untreated. Then he explained various options for treatment and gave me his recommendation to insert a tiny laser fiber into my leg  to inject the vein with high heat which seals the vein and solves the leakage problem. The body then absorbs the sealed vein over time and creates a new vein if necessary. This procedure has around a 98% success rate.

The surgery was handled in the most professional way in the operation room at Rajavej hospital. All the staff were kind and helpful. Dr. Kittipan was very reassuring as well.

The surgery only took a short time, maybe just under one hour! I was awake through the process and felt no pain other than the quick, initial anesthetic injection. I spent around one more hour in the recovery area walking around to make sure all was well. There were no problems whatsoever and although I got a ride home just to be safe, I honestly felt I could have driven myself home from the hospital!

I hardly had any pain in my leg after the surgery, just a bit of tenderness. I barely even had any need for pain medication afterward. I was given an elastic nylon stocking to wear from my foot to my knee which really helped to support my leg for the week after the surgery. I was told I should walk around 30 minutes per day to help with the healing process. This was no problem.

There was a waterproof bandage on my leg so that I could shower regularly until Dr. Kittipan removed the bandage at our one week follow up appointment at his clinic. At my one month follow up visit, I was shown by ultrasound how the vein had been absorbed and the leakage problem solved.

I honestly can’t think of how the surgery could have been any easier, less invasive or problem free! I have had complete trust in Dr. Kittipan throughout this process. He has been very helpful in talking with me about various vein issues I have and the different options for treating spider veins that might just need easy, in clinic cosmetic treatment to varicose veins like mine that require minor surgery.

I highly recommend Dr. Kittipan and his leg/vein clinic. Act quickly so that your problem will not increase in severity. He can direct you regarding the best option for you.
